decisive_items: 20×20 mm round cystic mass at the base of the tongue
33×31×27 mm well-defined cystic lesion in the midline of the tongue base
response.rationale: A midline cystic tongue-base mass causing epiglottic displacement and airway obstruction is classic for a vallecular cyst; OSA is the resulting syndrome rather than the underlying lesion.

rejected.why: Hypertension is a comorbidity and not the cause of the tongue-base mass or OSA.
Obstructive sleep apnea is the physiologic consequence confirmed by polysomnography, not the underlying diagnosis.
Base of tongue cyst is a less specific descriptor of the same finding; vallecular cyst is the more precise diagnosis.
